english_source_note: Equivalent Statements of the Prime Number Theorem
callout_id: 素数定理的一些等价命题#1
english_title: Some Equivalent Statements of the Prime Number Theorem (Landau 1909)
statement_en:
The following statements are equivalent:
1. $\pi(x)\sim \frac{x}{\log(x)}$
2. $\vartheta(x)\sim x$
3. $\sum_{n\leq x}\frac{\Lambda(n)}{n}=\log(x)-\gamma+o(1)$
4. $\psi(x):=\sum_{n\leq x}\Lambda(n)\sim x$
5. $\sum_{n\leq x}\mu(n)=o(x)$
6. $\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{\mu(n)}{n}=0$
key_techniques: equivalent formulations of the prime number theorem
prerequisites: prime counting function and asymptotic notation
